description: November 24 birthday meaning: Sagittarius decan 1, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 24 birthday falls in Sagittarius, in the first decan, with Jupiter as the sign's ruler and Jupiter as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Sagittarius is mutable and fire.

sections.heading: The November 24 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: One degree into Sagittarius, November 24 carries Jupiter's double influence, expansive and generous, alongside 6, the number of responsibility and home. Interpretively, it is an optimist who wants to share good fortune with the people nearby: hosting big gatherings, teaching younger relatives, or making sure everyone at the table has a second helping.

Astronomically, November 24 puts the Sun near 1° Sagittarius in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Jupiter. Jupiter rules Sagittarius and presides over its first decan as well, from about November 23 to December 1. This is traditionally the most expansive, optimistic stretch of the sign. Natives are often described as adventurous, generous and philosophical, eager to travel, learn and share whatever they have discovered. Humour and candour come easily, and so can a tendency to say the true thing a little too bluntly. Doubled Jupiter can make commitments multiply faster than time allows. These Archers tend to thrive when their search for meaning has room to roam but also somewhere to come home to.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for November 24
paragraphs: A birthday on the 24th reduces as 2 + 4 = 6. The compound combines the 2's emotional attentiveness and the 4's reliability, feeding into the 6's devotion to home and community. Those born on this day are often described as dependable carers: the one who brings soup, fixes the shelf and remembers what you said last month. Stability in family life tends to matter a great deal to them. As a secondary number, the 24 points towards a gift for creating safe, well-run spaces. Accepting help in return is often their quiet area of growth.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a November 24 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 2 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous November 24 birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 24 is the 328th day of the year (329th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Capricorn, is usually complete within 28 days, by December 22.

By November 24 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a November 24 birthday are Zachary Taylor (1784), Dale Carnegie (1888) and Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec (1864).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 24?
faq.answer: November 24 is Sagittarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Sagittarius, which tradition links with Jupiter.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 24?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 24 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 2 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 24th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 24?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 24, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 24?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on November 24 include Zachary Taylor (1784), Dale Carnegie (1888) and Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec (1864). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
